brief: Hungarian coverage of banking supervision and payments regulation is concentrated in a small, stable set of Hungarian-language outlets: Portfolio.hu is the clear leader for MNB fines and payment-law breaches, with Vilaggazdasag, hvg.hu and Napi.hu as mainstream cross-checks and Magyar Nemzet supplying the government/MNB-leadership framing. A distinct tier of small fintech trade blogs (FinTechZone, Fintech.hu, FintechRadar, Privatbankar's fintech tag) carries the most operationally useful signal for this workstream: instant-payment (AFR) rulebook releases, feature postponements and concrete effective dates that rarely get standalone official press releases. English-language coverage of Hungarian financial regulation is thin in local press and is better served by vendor and legal channels — Vixio for payments enforcement, Lexology and Baker McKenzie's jurisdiction guide for draft rules and deadlines. Practical caveat: generic keyword search surfaces mnb.hu and net.jogtar.hu ahead of journalism, so this cell should be collected via per-outlet tag pages and RSS rather than search, with paywalls limiting free access to headline and date.
